applicable_when: The kernel computes a GEMM (M=2250, N=112, K=480) with fixed BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=64, BLOCK_K=32. This produces only 72 tiles (ceil(2250/64)=36 x ceil(112/64)=2), which is less than the 132 SMs on the GPU - only 0.14 waves. Additionally, 128 registers/thread limits each SM to 4 blocks (25% theoretical occupancy), and achieved occupancy is only 6.25% because the tiny grid leaves most SMs idle. The 12-way shared memory bank conflicts (77.63% of wavefronts) add further latency. Reducing BLOCK_M and BLOCK_N increases the tile count, spreads work across more SMs, and reduces register pressure per thread. Adding @triton.autotune explores the best configuration automatically.
